data.source: authenticated Alpaca CLI 0.0.14 historical stock bars

family: stateful shadow-clock early-week ETF shock reversal
limitations: The 2022-2026 evidence is iteratively reused pseudo-OOS, not a sealed future period.
Alpaca IEX daily bars are not consolidated SIP and contain no bid/ask replay.
The shadow clock is causal but adds state: skipped Thursday/Friday virtual positions can delay later execution.
Historical fills use conservative explicit costs but do not model market impact or shorting because the strategy is long-only.
Results are a backtest, not guaranteed future P&L.

method.disclosure: The dataset was reused during iterative search; no window is represented as an untouched future holdout.

neighborhood.definition: 108 immediate parameter combinations around shock, close-location, ATR stop, and hold

production_contract.ambiguity: stop first when daily OHLC contains both target and stop
production_contract.cooldown: shadow position owns its exit session; next signal may complete the following session
production_contract.cross_section: choose the most negative normalized two-day shock among 11 liquid ETFs
production_contract.execution_calendar: submit only signals completed Monday, Tuesday, or Wednesday
production_contract.market_state: always advance one virtual shadow position across all weekdays
production_contract.risk: one ATR stop, cent-rounded after-cost >=3R target, five-session maximum hold
production_contract.signal: long-only; close above 100-day SMA and 50-day SMA above 100-day SMA; two-day return <= -0.6 ATR; close in bottom 25% of daily range
